This document out lines the testing procedures 
P1, to be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Wagdy Eid 
Mansour, tested by eng Magdy Saad at 25 Oct 2004, reviewed by EDEPC quality 
control eng. Abd El-Menem El-Emam, accepted by general director eng. Yousry Abd 
El-Maksuod, and approved by eng. Awad Fathy head sector of Talkha PS.

 issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category

Personal 
protective equipment must be used safety shoes, safety helmet, ground strap 
...etc.

Safety 
 helmet and safety shoes, ... etc.

Remove two servo valves (stop & control) 
 from the unit.
Check the oil seal and change it if damage.

Clean filters for two servo valves
 (stop & control).
Clean slots for two servo valves (stop & control).

Measure two coil resistor for each valve which must be 
 in permissive limit (1.08 kW) and if reading is not correct change the valve.

Assemble two servo valve ( stop & control ) 
 again in unit.

Measure output voltage from stop/speed 
 ratio valve servo card (SSVD) in Speedtronic on LCTB1 (C 10,11 
 & C13,14) to check if o/p voltage (6.5 0.2) VDC (operation 
 limits for servo valve 90 SR )

Measure the same o/p voltage from SSVD card 
 beside stop / speed ratio valve in ( JB 2 ) on point (19-20) & (17 18) to check if o/p voltage run servo valve 90 SR.

Measure output voltage from gas control valve card (SSVG) in
 Speedtronic on LCTB1 (C 22,23 
 & C25,26) to check if output voltage (6.5 0.2) VDC 
 (operation limits for servo valve 65 GC ).

Measure the same o/p voltage from SSVG card 
 beside stop / speed ratio valve in (JB 2) on point (21,22) & (23 24) 
 to check if o/p voltage run servo valve 65 GC.

If there is different in reading o/p voltage of SSVD & SSVG cards from 
 resistance R92 (3) FROM ssvd & resistance R90 (1) from SSVG

If two cards SSVD & SSVG not respond we change two cards SSVD & SSVG and and 
 repeat steps from (6 to 9)
